label: upgrade-legacy.mjs is already the safe old-tree migrator: it validates every packet, runs only failing packets through a fixed step order, records what the tools cannot clear in upgrade-baseline.json (validator reports recorded findings as warnings, unlisted findings stay errors), never involves a language model, is dry by default, and never rewrites archived snapshots; exit 0/1/2.
The pipeline order is fill-frontmatter, heal-spec-docs, repair-derived, migrate-generated-json, then record remaining findings; the dry run prints exactly that sequence.

The fill-frontmatter step adds missing frontmatter keys through frontmatter-migration.ts and never rewrites a key a document has; that owns the one-off add-fm-fields.mjs job (importance_tier/contextType recovery).

heal-spec-docs.cjs restores only literal template values (default trigger phrases per doc class; a template-source header only when the document's anchors match that template's anchor set), refuses documents with no frontmatter, and its dry run doubles as the census.

repair-derived.cjs repairs description level only from the packet's own declaration, the recorded location (Spec Folder row and packet_pointer), and re-derives graph metadata; DERIVABLE/REDERIVABLE sets name which rules each class settles and authored rules are refused.
migrate-generated-json.ts computes specFolder from the folder's real position under specs and rewrites generated JSON, owning the one-off fix-specfolder.mjs.

Two capabilities have no permanent owner: anchor-structure repair (no pipeline step edits anchors; heal-spec-docs only reads them as provenance evidence) and missing required-document reconstruction (upgrade-legacy records but cannot rebuild; phase 013 used lane work with dated notes).

Verdict per one-off script: fix-specfolder.mjs and add-fm-fields.mjs are already owned by pipeline steps; fix-dup-anchors.mjs needs a new prose-preserving anchor step; missing-document reconstruction should stay a recorded human-lane defect because no algorithm can supply what a document says.

direction: Building a second migration pipeline beside upgrade-legacy.mjs
reason: It already has the step order, dry-run default, grandfathering record and archive protection a pre-v4 migration needs; new repairs belong as steps inside it.

direction: Auto-reconstructing missing documents in the heal pipeline
reason: Reconstruction asserts what a document says; both repair tools refuse authored facts on principle.
